title: Yo Phone Linging
blurb: The mispronunciation is the entire meme, and it is doing an enormous amount of work. Announcing that your phone is ringing should require no announcement at all, which is why the deep-fried delivery lands — it takes the most redundant sentence available and shouts it through several layers of compression. Set it as an actual ringtone if you are brave, play it whenever somebody's phone goes off in a quiet public place, or use it to flag a call that should very clearly not be answered. Linging intensifies.
origin: A viral deep-fried 'your phone ringing' announcement clip.
